reviews.text: Dr. Sergio and the receptionist were absolutely wonderful. My cats (Iyani and Cowei) were thrilled, and I was so happy with the service and attention. Believe me, choosing this policy at the Arena shopping center was the best decision I've ever made! 😊😊😊😊🐈‍⬛🐈❤️🩷🩵💙🧡💛💜 …
Mauricio helped us and everything was great.

Without a doubt, the best veterinary clinic in all of Valencia! Impeccable staff, very friendly and professional. Everything is very clean, and they treat our pets with great care and love. I recommend it 100%! ☺️
Without a doubt… Mauricio & Mauricio ARE THE BEST!!!!
Spectacular clinic in the center. Both the veterinarians and the reception staff were excellent. 100% recommended. Sergio explained all the tests to me.

I've been taking my two dogs to Sergio for a while now, and I couldn't be more grateful. He's an exceptional veterinarian, incredibly professional, and above all, a person with immense love for animals. My dogs go into the clinic happy, and that says it all. Sergio always treats them with care, patience, and dedication, explaining every detail clearly and instilling a lot of confidence. Finding someone who combines so much humanity with such professionalism is a true gift. I wholeheartedly recommend him!
A big hug to the whole Canitas team at CC Arena, especially to Gos! ❤️🐶 A shout-out to Mauri, from Dakota royalty 🤣 Next time, red carpet treatment! 😂🤪
Perfect! I love it… Dr., Administration, team, highly recommended 100%
Excellent service from veterinarian Mauricio ❤️ We loved it. And the receptionist, also named Mauricio, was so kind 🥹

We are delighted with the care our dog Asher received.

Maurizio, the vet, is wonderful, and the staff are great too.

We are very grateful. We highly recommend Canitas.

Thank you, Óscar and Joa.
Excellent service, 100% recommended

I'm so happy with my first experience at Canitas. Both Sergio and Mauricio were wonderful; they treated my kitten Mia with so much love and respect and explained the insurance policy and my kitten's condition very well. Thank you so much! I'll definitely be back!
Excellent service, very fast and professional, 100% recommended
The service was fantastic, they were so kind to our dog. We're delighted with the staff, they're all amazing, thank you ☺️

Excellent service, they are always very kind and attentive during consultations, always looking after the furry ones. We received assistance from Mauricio to manage all the appointments, and his charisma is unmatched. Our veterinarian, Mauricio, is a very professional and caring person; he always gives our kitten lots of love 🐱
Dr. Sergio is so sweet with the dog; she's three months old and hasn't even noticed the vaccine. We'll definitely be going back to him.

I love it! It's the third time I've taken him there, and it gets better every time because they do exactly what I ask, no more, no less, respecting what I want them to cut and what I don't, without judgment or bad attitude 😊. My little guy comes out super happy and not stressed at all, and I'm happy for another month to have him clean, groomed, and with his long hair.

Excellent service from the reception desk to the consultation room; everyone was very friendly.

Sergio, who is incredibly helpful, took care of us. My dog ​​was due for his vaccination, and since he's very nervous, I was so surprised that he didn't even feel the injection.
At the first appointment, they wanted to keep my baby!!! Hahaha...so happy!!! The service was incredible, and my little one didn't even notice the vaccine!!! I highly recommend it!!!

We loved it! Today was my puppy's first appointment and everything went great. They gave us all the advice we asked for, the staff was super attentive and very caring. I definitely feel safe leaving my puppy in their hands. Thank you so much to Sergio for this first consultation! 🩵🐶 …
Very professional, attentive, and prompt service. Although it was our first visit, they treated our pet like a regular patient. We will be back. Thank you so much for your service.

Sergio is a wonderful veterinarian. He examined my kitten's eye ulcer, looking at every last detail, explaining everything to me right then and there without any confusion. He was also incredibly kind and charming.

And Mauri, the receptionist, is super friendly and attentive to the animals that visit the clinic, asking what's wrong and how they're doing. They're both wonderful people. 😊
Very professional
Excellent treatment from both the tutor and the patient. Highly recommended, very happy.
Cañitas is the best. Hairdresser Sonia and receptionist Mauricio are ALWAYS the best!!!
Excellent service! We took my dog ​​to the groomer and they treated her wonderfully. The whole team was super friendly and they made her look beautiful. Highly recommended!
Excellent service, Sergio and Alicia were impeccable. My dog ​​is very energetic, but with patience and care from this fantastic team, he was handled without any problems. Thank you!
Juana, thank you so much for the 5 stars! 🎉 We're so glad to have you in the family, come back soon! 😊 …
Sergio and Mauricio are lovely, Sergio is very kind, they treated my cat and us wonderfully, bringing our pet here was a great decision.

Thank you Verónica M. B. for the 5 stars! ✨🙏
You're one of us — come back soon for more surprises and good vibes! 🎉❤️ …
We love Mau's service at reception and Doc Mau! Canitas de Arenas is the best. We wish all the Canitas were like the one in Arenas.
